lines.say: helps turn hemoglobin that can't carry oxygen back to normal (approved use)
7% more correct memory answers than placebo after one use (small study, 26 healthy adults)
a related compound (LMTM) missed its main goals in an 891-person Alzheimer's trial
G6PD tested first, since G6PD deficiency rules it out
boxed warning: serious or fatal serotonin syndrome with antidepressants or opioids
red blood cells can break down (hemolytic anemia), especially with G6PD deficiency
confusion, dizziness and vision problems that can affect driving
turns urine blue, which can interfere with urine tests

ask: Could methylene blue interact with my antidepressant, pain medicine or other prescriptions, and would stopping either one be safe?
